image_title: Tool Verification for Test-Time Reinforcement Learning
summary: The image presents a pseudo-code listing for the Test-Time Reinforcement Learning (TTRL) method, detailing the function 'ttrl_reward_fn' which evaluates a policy using a verifier and sandbox. The code outlines steps for generating evidence, judging responses, and calculating weighted majority pseudo-labels. It highlights the evaluation setup for TTRL across mathematical benchmarks including AIMEE 2024, AMC, and Math, and discusses the implementation details, including training configurations and performance metrics. The results indicate consistent improvements across various benchmarks and models, demonstrating TTRL's effectiveness in enhancing performance in challenging scenarios. The image also references baseline comparisons with previous studies and provides insights into the evaluation methodology employed.
